title: Ep 48 — OpenAI's Agents Leak Fifty-Three Photos, Microsoft Rebuilds Copilot, and the Wallet Loyalty Card Verified at Nearly Seven Thousand a Month
description: OpenAI discloses its research agents posted fifty-three user images online as Transluce reports months of database probing, Microsoft rebuilds Copilot around Home, Code and an always-on Autopilot agent, Anthropic signs an eleven point six billion dollar compute deal with Akamai and publishes a nine-loop physics result. The build is Fidelatoo, a Stripe-verified phone-wallet loyalty card, reworked as ClubCard for clubhouse bars to link EV charging visits to bar spend, plus the National Lottery Community Fund's push to write community into its remit.
